name: Behalf.bot - FounderOS
description: A gated coach for early-stage founders. It walks a founder through a fixed sequence of stages, from why and founder fit through audience, pain research, discovery, solution test, positioning, content, validation and traction. Each stage ends in a gate that needs ledger evidence, not self-report. Content (framework cards, concept notes, skills, gate specs, Laya question sets) is markdown and JSON in git; founder state lives in a ledger behind a storage interface. Ships the stage 0-9 cards and gates, ten stage skills that walk a founder from stage to gate against the ledger (scripts/stage.py), concept notes, four auditor skills (Mom Test interview audit, pain tagger and pain-log check, earlyvangelist qualifier, Pain-Dream-Fix checker) with Laya tagging and a Claude-only fallback, coach skills, an eval harness that scores skills and cards against plain Claude, a Basic track (basic/: five stages, nineteen cards, a short paraphrase of Amy Hoy and Alex Hillman's 30x500 that names the lesson behind each card) with its own coach and review skills, a Post-revenue track (post-revenue/: seven stages, twenty-three cards, visible but not yet startable), and the founder bundle: a `founder-os export` / `founder-os import` CLI plus an opt-in, signed progress webhook, and the Safari runner: a heartbeat that claims the student's painstorm and e-bomb analysis jobs from the Vibecode Lisboa Safari Hub and runs them through the local `claude -p` on the student's own Claude plan.

enabled.description: Master switch. Enables the stage, auditor and coach skills and runs setup.sh and validate.sh.

include_contrib.description: Load community cards from contrib/ in addition to core/. Off by default: the coach loads only core/, and founders never see contrib content unless the operator opts in. Exported as FOUNDER_OS_INCLUDE_CONTRIB.

ledger_backend.description: Where founder state is stored. postgres uses the chassis database named by BEHALFBOT_PG_DSN or CHASSIS_PG_DSN (the same variables the chassis already sets). sqlite is for development and tests. Exported as FOUNDER_OS_LEDGER_BACKEND.

ledger_pg_schema.description: Postgres schema the ledger tables live in. The plugin creates it if missing and never reads or writes outside it, so its generic table names (artifacts, labels, audits) cannot collide with other tables in the chassis database. Exported as FOUNDER_OS_PG_SCHEMA.

ledger_sqlite_path.description: SQLite ledger file, used only when ledger_backend is sqlite. Exported as FOUNDER_OS_SQLITE_PATH.

files_dir.description: Content-addressed store for original files attached to artifacts (artifacts.meta.files[].sha256). Founder bundles export and import them from here. Exported as FOUNDER_OS_FILES_DIR.

progress_webhook_url.description: Opt-in. The per-student https URL a cohort instructor gave you. When set, founder-os progress POSTs exactly stage, gate_status and updated_at to it, and nothing else from the ledger. Empty (the default) means nothing is ever sent. Requires progress_webhook_secret. Exported as FOUNDER_OS_PROGRESS_WEBHOOK_URL. See docs/bundle-format.md, Progress webhook.

progress_webhook_secret.description: Shared HMAC-SHA256 signing key the instructor issued with the URL. Every webhook request is signed with it so the instructor can reject forged or replayed reports. Keep it in the operator's secret store, not in a committed file. Exported as FOUNDER_OS_PROGRESS_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

agent_base_url.description: Safari Hub the runner claims jobs from. Override only to test against a staging or local Hub; plain http is accepted for localhost only. Exported as FOUNDER_OS_AGENT_BASE_URL.

agent_key.description: The vcl_fos_ agent key from Safari Hub settings (Run Safari work on: My BehalfBot). Empty (the default) means the runner does nothing. Set it with `founder-os runner setup`, which writes FOUNDER_OS_AGENT_KEY to the install's .env (the file the dispatcher sources before every gather); never put it in chassis.config.yaml or any committed file. Deliberately not in contracts.env, so an activation-time export of an empty value can never shadow the real key.

activation._note: Stage, auditor and coach skills are invoked on demand from a founder session. The one scheduled job is the founder-os-safari-runner heartbeat, and it is opt-in twice: it must be added to the install's HEARTBEATS.md (block in README.md, Safari runner), and it does nothing until `founder-os runner setup` has stored an agent key. Point it at scripts/gather-safari-runner.sh with the prompt template in scheduled-tasks/, schedule every 2m. The dispatcher tick is the floor on cadence (DISPATCHER_INTERVAL_SECONDS, 900 by default), so a 2-minute cadence needs that lowered to 120. The gate does the work itself: with nothing queued it is one HTTP request and zero tokens, and the dispatcher's own model fires only when the key is rejected or the claude CLI is missing.

system.name: python3
system.install: apt-get install python3 (Debian) / your platform's package manager
system._explanation: Runs the content lint (validate.sh) and the ledger storage interface. Both are stdlib-only apart from the Postgres driver below.

system.name: psycopg
system.install: pip install psycopg==3.2.3 (already in the chassis image)
system._explanation: Postgres driver for the ledger's Postgres adapter. The chassis image ships psycopg 3.2.3, so setup.sh only checks for it and never installs it. It is a soft dependency: without it the SQLite backend still works, and setup.sh warns instead of failing.

system.name: laya
system.install: Optional. A laya-serve or Ollaya instance reachable over HTTP. Set LAYA_URL (e.g. http://laya:8000), and LAYA_API_KEY if the server requires a bearer token. LAYA_TIMEOUT sets seconds per request (default 20).
system._explanation: The auditors send per-item questions to Laya's /v1/systemone endpoint. It is a soft dependency: with LAYA_URL unset, or the server down or timing out, every auditor returns mode claude-only and Claude does the tagging. Nothing is installed or started from this plugin.

_declares._why: CONTRIBUTING.md asks a plugin to declare everything it touches. This block covers the Safari runner; the rest of the plugin reaches only the ledger, Laya when configured, and the progress webhook when configured.
network_egress: agent_base_url (https://vibecodelisboa.com by default) - GET /api/founder-os/agent/jobs/next and POST /api/founder-os/agent/jobs/:id/result on each heartbeat tick, only when an agent key is set
_declares.credentials: FOUNDER_OS_AGENT_KEY, read from the environment only and sent only as the Bearer header to agent_base_url. Never logged, never passed to the claude child process. The runner never reads ~/.claude, the keychain or any OAuth credential: it starts the claude CLI the student already logged into, with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY removed from the child's environment so the work bills the student's Claude plan.
_declares.subprocesses: claude -p --output-format json --tools "" --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources "" --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --append-system-prompt <skill> [--model <model>], prompt on stdin, in an empty temporary directory. No tools and no MCP servers.
filesystem: ${CUSTOMER_HOME}/.env (and .env.baked when present) - written by `founder-os runner setup` only, mode 0600
a temporary empty directory per claude call, removed afterwards
